text: On XX/XX/XXXX I deposited a check for $3,200.00 at the branch and was told it would clear in two days. Instead my account was frozen and the funds were held for 12 days. My rent payment bounced and I was charged a $34.00 overdraft fee. I called three times and each time the representative said a different department was handling it. Nobody ever called me back. I want the fee refunded and my money released.

I have had this credit card since XXXX. When I renewed, the agent on the phone told me the $95.00 annual fee would be waived. Two months later the fee appeared on my statement anyway. When I called, a supervisor said there was no record of the promise and refused to remove it. I am 71 years old and on a fixed income. This is misleading and I would like the fee reversed.

text: Since the app update on XX/XX/XXXX I cannot log in. The app says my session expired every time and then locks me out. text: I was scammed through Zelle. Someone pretending to be from the bank called me from the number on the back of my card and convinced me to send $2,500.00 to protect my account. I reported it within an hour. The bank denied my claim saying I authorized the transfer. I am a servicemember and this was my deployment savings. I have filed a police report. The bank did nothing to stop it and refuses to refund me.

text:
CUSTOMER: Hi, I was charged a $35.00 overdraft fee yesterday even though my paycheck was deposited the same morning.
AGENT: I am sorry about that. Let me look at the account. I can see the deposit posted after the debit card purchase.
CUSTOMER: The deposit was there at 8am, I checked the app. This is the second time this year and I am really frustrated.
AGENT: I understand. As a courtesy I can refund the $35.00 fee today, and I will put a note on the account.
CUSTOMER: Thank you, I appreciate that. Please make sure it does not happen again.
